repository_policy.verification: Official Komatsu product and brochure sources are URL-bound. Published drawings constrain listed dimensions only and are not imported as scale geometry.

sources.title: PC210LC-11 Mid-size Excavator
sources.applicability: Regional PC210LC-11 conventional identity and product-class anchor as retrieved 2026-08-29. No local immutable page capture is admitted, so no dimensional or configuration-equivalence fact depends on this URL-only source.

sources.title: PC210LC-11 / PC210LCi-11
sources.applicability: Pages 20-22 establish the cited engine specification, two-boom/one-arm/one-bucket cylinder topology and strokes, 5.7 m boom, 2.925 m arm, 700 mm shoes, transport dimensions, working range and compatible TL bucket. The pages 1-2 operating-weight range is explicitly brochure-family scope, not a conventional-only column. iMC hardware is excluded from the modeled candidate.
